construct_qualification_v2.scope: Outcome-blind qualification of the construct, endpoint hierarchy, design identifiability, and analysis preregistration only.

relation_type_balanced_nested_permutatio.construction: five cyclic family rotations crossed with two inverse-direction phases; each dose is the prefix of its permutation

length_disentanglement.design: Every permutation and relation-count dose is crossed with both exact CLIP-token target arms.
length_disentanglement.no_truncation_gate: Materialized prompts must tokenize to exactly the assigned target with openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 and must retain EOS before position 77.
length_disentanglement.semantic_identity_gate: The two length arms must compile to the identical ordered instructed relation triplets; only preregistered meaning-preserving relation templates and non-relational discourse wrappers may differ.
length_disentanglement.wrapper_sensitivity: Use two counterbalanced wrapper banks; report their interaction and do not interpret beta_length as a universal pure-token law if wrapper heterogeneity is detected.
length_disentanglement.materialization_fail_closed: Any object name or template that cannot reach both targets without relation loss, truncation, or a new spatial/attribute constraint is excluded before outcomes.

primary.name: relation_level_iRecall
primary.aggregation: sum(satisfied) / number of instructed relation triplets; preserve one row per triplet before any scene aggregation
primary.matching: official InstructScene exact relation occurrence evaluator; the easy closely-collapsed score is diagnostic only

secondary.name: exact_all_success
secondary.record: 1 iff every instructed relation triplet is satisfied

analysis_preregistration.population: all qualified materialized base scenes, seeds, permutations, doses, and both length arms; failures remain rows under the frozen failure policy

primary_model.formula: satisfied ~ relation_count_c * clip_token_count_c + relation_family + direction_phase + addition_position_c + wrapper_bank + relation_count_c:wrapper_bank + (1 + relation_count_c | base_scene_id) + (1 | base_scene_id:relation_triplet_id) + (1 | seed)
primary_model.primary_estimand: average marginal relation-count contrast at each preregistered dose, averaged over token targets, relation families, directions, wrappers, base scenes, and seeds
primary_model.text_length_estimand: average marginal contrast 68 versus 52 CLIP tokens at each dose
primary_model.simultaneous_effect_requirement: relation-count and realized token-length terms remain in the same fitted model regardless of individual significance

secondary_model.formula: exact_all_success ~ relation_count_c * clip_token_count_c + direction_phase + wrapper_bank + (1 + relation_count_c | base_scene_id) + (1 | seed)
secondary_model.multiplicity: secondary endpoint is interpreted only after the primary hierarchy; no substitution for relation-level iRecall

boundary_modeling_after_primary.selection: grouped cross-validation by base_scene_id; breakpoint claim requires out-of-sample improvement and stable scene-cluster bootstrap interval
boundary_modeling_after_primary.no_breakpoint_policy: report smooth capacity degradation and do not claim a boundary

analysis_preregistration.missingness_and_failure: No complete-case deletion for generation/evaluator failures. Fit the relation model with failure-coded unsatisfied relations as primary and repeat with failures separated as a sensitivity analysis.

if_both_pass_only: propose official two-stage InstructScene training GPU authority
